changeLog: Added new features and bug fixes!
siteChangeLog:
- Revamped Radio Mode (stability fixes still ongoing)
- Revamped weather system and seasonal effects
- Optimized drawing canvas and brush performance
- General app performance optimizations
- New Team room: cleaner layout, simple QR invite, host/guest roles, auto-hidden invites when the room is full
- Synced radio: listen along with the host
- Host-only posting in shared rooms, with a clear message for guests
- Your own design is now safe while in a room and returns when you leave
- Host can resume a room after a refresh
- Terms & Conditions shown before posting
- Wall tiles can now only be claimed next to existing art
